Field.Name: ProtectionDeltaLimit
Field.Description: The limit of the delta value per underlying within the exposure time interval when market maker protection is triggered. When this value is met or exceeded the system automatically removes the quotes for the instruments connected to the underlying. Maximum 4 decimal places.

Field.Description: Maximum Quote Quantity (MQQ) in base currency. The total combined size of open MMP orders per side, per order book (instrument), cannot exceed MQQ. MQQ limits cumulative order size, not the number of orders. Order book = instrument, MQQ is per instrument (not sum across instruments): "Per order book" means per instrument (not per expiry). MQQ is enforced separately for each instrument and applies
